Finally, a API/FailFastDescription RuboCop cop that had been added to enforce the annotation in source code was removed. After confirming that desc is only consumed by the OpenAPI gem — never in error messages, logs, or any other runtime path — the cop was deemed redundant since the gem appends the annotation automatically regardless of what the developer writes.
